colourSuffixesPublished.note: page title 'C/FTXA-AW/BB/BT/BS' + product photos label FTXA-AW (white), FTXA-BS (wood effect), FTXA-BT (silver), FTXA-BB (black). Colour words: 'couleur blanche, noire, argent ou effet bois'. Colour->suffix binding per photo captions; AW=white, BS=wood, BT=silver, BB=black. These are distinct references when named.

pairingEvidence: Monosplit pairing is evidenced by the shared efficiency-table column headers of the form 'FTXA + RXA': '20AW/BS/BT/BB + 20A9', '25AW/BS/BT/BB + 25A9', '35AW/BS/BT/BB + 35A9', '42AW/BS/BT/BB + 42B', '50AW/BS/BT/BB + 50B'. The 15-class indoor 'CTXA15AW/BS/BT/BB' has NO matching RXA outdoor column on p.42. A vertical merged band 'Possibilité de connexion uniquement aux unités extérieures multi' spans the efficiency table: a CAVEAT that connection is only to multi outdoor units, so monosplit RXA pairing per shared column is the table structure but the multi-only caveat must be flagged; never assume all R32 devices pair.
